title: Jyväskylä, Central Finland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Jyväskylä, Central Finland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Jyväskylä is a city in Central Finland with a population of 143,000. A lively university city between lakes, known for its Alvar Aalto architecture and outdoor sports opportunities. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
